items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I went down and played along-side of him. ... Diffy's orchestra, and we had two banjos.

ctx.x: You didn't get to hear any of the --

I got to hear Whiteman later on, I think. I heard him play a concert at the Masonic Hall in Wilkes Barre and went up with our former piano player, Diffy who lived up near there. We got together, we went in and we heard him do -- Morton Downey was even with him then, because that was later. They did the Rhapsody, we wanted to hear the Rhapsody. Ross Gorman, he played it and I still think he plays it -- he understands it. It was written, it's like it was written for him. And I think he does it better than a lot of…
